response.text: Invoice 733 mismatches its journal. Now duplicates, payment/journal ties, and period checks.

arguments.sql: select a."INV_ID", b."INV_ID" as dup_id, a."VEND_CD", a."INV_NO", b."INV_NO" n2, a."INV_AMT", b."INV_AMT", a."INV_DT", b."INV_DT" from "APINVH" a join "APINVH" b on a."INV_ID"<b."INV_ID" and trim(a."VEND_CD")=trim(b."VEND_CD") and regexp_replace(lower(a."INV_NO"),'[^a-z0-9]','','g')=regexp_replace(lower(b."INV_NO"),'[^a-z0-9]','','g') order by 1

select a."INV_ID", b."INV_ID" d, a."VEND_CD", b."VEND_CD" v2, a."INV_NO", b."INV_NO" n2, a."INV_AMT", a."INV_DT", b."INV_DT" from "APINVH" a join "APINVH" b on a."INV_ID"<b."INV_ID" and a."INV_AMT"=b."INV_AMT" and trim(a."VEND_CD")=trim(b."VEND_CD") and a."INV_DT"=b."INV_DT" order by 1

select p."PAY_ID", p."INV_ID", p."PAY_AMT", p."PAY_DT", i."INV_AMT", i."INV_DT", h."JRNL_NO", s.dr, s.cr from "APPAYM" p join "APINVH" i on i."INV_ID"=p."INV_ID" left join "GLJRNH" h on h."SRC_REF"='PAY-'||p."PAY_ID" left join (select "JRNL_NO", sum("DR_AMT") dr, sum("CR_AMT") cr from "GLJRNL" group by 1) s on s."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO" where h."JRNL_NO" is null or s.dr<>p."PAY_AMT" or s.cr<>p."PAY_AMT" or p."PAY_DT"<i."INV_DT" or p."PAY_AMT"<>i."INV_AMT" order by 1

select i."INV_ID", i."INV_DT", h."JRNL_NO", h."PRD_ID", h."POST_DT", h."SRC_CD", p."STRT_DT", p."END_DT" from "APINVH" i join "GLJRNH" h on h."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" join "GLPERD" p on p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" where i."INV_DT" not between p."STRT_DT" and p."END_DT" or h."SRC_CD"<>'AP' order by 1
